title: Identification of secretory protein related biomarkers for primary biliary cholangitis based on machine learning and experimental validation.
summary: Machine-learning analyses identify candidate secretory-protein biomarkers for primary biliary cholangitis with experimental validation.
ai_technology: Discovery datasets are followed by independent sample/expression testing of selected candidates.

evidence.tested: Candidate biomarkers and validation are limited to the cohorts and assays studied; no clinical screening benefit is shown.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Discovery datasets are followed by independent sample/expression testing of selected candidates.
